model.name: WebItem mint bypasses the class — drop-dispatcher pseudo-fallback (url.split.pop) names a valid URL badly + skips url-validation; the class must own name + validation at mint
model.description: LIVE (architect full-path execution + expert reproduce, decisive measurement): drop-dispatcher.ts:133 sets name = displayName || url.split(SLASH).pop() || link, so a valid YouTube URL with no human displayName is named "watch?v=X"; deriveName (WebItem.ts:46) returns the fallback VERBATIM = the class name derivation never runs. A VALID url gets a BAD name = a live violation of R40.105 (class owns its name). Plus (PO robustness): the mint does not validate/normalize the url, so a domain-less/invalid input mints a broken hostless WebItem. FIX (expert-proposed, architect-backed): drop the url.split.pop pseudo-fallback so the WebItem CLASS derives its own name when no human displayName, AND validate/normalize the url at mint. Fix WHERE THE OBJECT IS MADE = closes the class regardless of source (the shape Tron keeps demanding). The 4 restore WebItems on Bug 88df8e4e are re-derived by this fix.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The WebItem NAME is derived by the CLASS (deriveName(url)), NOT by the drop-dispatcher url.split(SLASH).pop() pseudo-fallback. EXECUTED PROOF: deriveName(youtubeURL, "watch?v=X")="watch?v=X" (bug) vs deriveName(youtubeURL, undefined)="Youtube Watch" (correct). FIX: drop the url.split.pop pseudo-fallback so the class derives its own name when no human displayName. LIVE violation of R40.105 (class owns its name).

gateRef.ref: test drop YouTube URL names it
gateRef.assertion: a valid YouTube (or any) URL dropped with no displayName is named by the class (proper name), NOT its raw tail fragment; a valid url named by its url.split.pop fragment => RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: The WebItem mint VALIDATES + NORMALIZES the url: a domain-less/invalid input is REJECTED or RECONSTRUCTED (proper url with host), NEVER persisted as a broken, hostless, unopenable WebItem. (PO robustness — closes the class regardless of input.)

gateRef.assertion: a domain-less/invalid input at mint is rejected or normalized to a valid url; a broken hostless WebItem persisted => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a domain-less input at mint -> a hostless/unopenable WebItem persisted => RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: The fix is at the WebItem MINT (the one choke where the object is made), so it closes the class REGARDLESS of source (drag, share-sheet, paste). A source path that mints a WebItem bypassing the class name+validation => RED.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The existing bad-named WebItems (the 4 restore on Bug 88df8e4e — valid urls, bad names) are RE-DERIVED by the fix (deriveName(url)), not left with the pseudo-fallback name. A restore/cleanup that keeps the bad name => RED.

gateRef.assertion: the 4 restore WebItems on 88df8e4e get class-derived names after the fix; a kept bad name => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed the 4 restored with their bad watch?v= names retained -> RED
